scripts.load:normal: mkdir -p tests/results && K6_PROFILE=normal k6 run --summary-export=tests/results/k6-normal.json tests/load/payment-flow.js
scripts.load:high: mkdir -p tests/results && K6_PROFILE=high k6 run --summary-export=tests/results/k6-high.json tests/load/payment-flow.js
scripts.load:spike: mkdir -p tests/results && K6_PROFILE=spike k6 run --summary-export=tests/results/k6-spike.json tests/load/payment-flow.js
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d postgres redis kafka kafka-init prometheus grafana
scripts.apps:up: docker compose up -d --build api-gateway order-service payment-service payment-worker
scripts.apps:down: docker compose stop api-gateway order-service payment-service payment-worker
